integrity: The coefficient follows from exact period averaging of the cited differential equation, the source's proved leading C^1 profile, and an exact cubic Taylor identity. No numerical experiment or finite truncation is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the local periodic-response families in the cited vector p-Laplacian Duffing example for p>2 and positive epsilon tending to zero. It identifies the mean term at scale epsilon^(2/(p-1)) but not the full next-order waveform or stability.
title: Curvature law for mean rectification in vector p-Laplacian Duffing responses
